contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment Roman samian ware form 37, vessel that has been exposed to fire and has a burnt outer surface AD.160-190. The vessel would have been a large bowl with straight walls with a decorated band. The sherd has a thin plain band beneath the rim followed by a band of ovolo decoration above the broader band of freestyle animal decoration similar to that used by the potter Paternus II, a Lezoux…
